question: Which of the following diseases damages the eye’s optic nerve and results in vision loss and blindness and occurs when the normal fluid pressure inside the eyes slowly rises?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Glaucoma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Glaucoma** is an eye condition caused by damaging the optic nerve.
 
• Due to increased eye pressure, the optic nerve gets damaged.&l
